text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Victoria Mile, Vivlos displayed a 
run worthy of Verxina's recognition. With 
bright smiles, the two praised each other 
for their valiant efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching quietly, their other sister, 
Cheval Grand, renewed her own resolve to 
grow stronger after witnessing the 
sisters' fierce clash.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To get closer to the dream of Dubai, 
Vivlos and her Trainer set their sights on 
the next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To gain experience against rivals who have 
raced overseas or aspire to go abroad, she 
decided to enter the Takarazuka Kinen.
